notes.title: Guilty Parade Episode 4: The Underside of the Past is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940776/6f1956d4f159b23ea45bdffe03e39fa58cd21764.png[/img]

[h1]Guilty Parade Episode 4: The Underside of the Past is out![/h1]

Many thanks to everyone who was eagerly waiting for the release, we are sorry that it was delayed due to problems with the release of the new build. The problem has now been resolved.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290390/Guilty_Parade_Episode_4/

[h1]FAQ:[/h1]

❓ Is this a sequel to Episode 4: The Underside of the Future?
No, this is an alternate route after Episode 3. Your decisions in Episodes 1-3 affect which route you end up on (the Underside of the Past or The Underside of the Future).

❓ Do I have to buy Episode 4: The Underside of the Past separately?
It comes bundled with Episode 4: The Underside of the Future. If you already have Episode 4 in your library, there is no need to purchase this route separately, just update the game.

[b]Attention![/b] Due to the engine and code major update, some saves may show an error. To avoid it try to load an earlier save file and skip the read dialogs (use Shift + > to fast skip). You can report a bug to our mail: NozoriGames@gmail.com. We apologize for the inconvenience and hope for your understanding!

Thanks for your support and enjoy!
[i]Noasaki and Orizori[/i]

notes.title: Guilty Parade Episode 2 is available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940776/20f1695e01d342b2580dd93c852f1393de651f05.png[/img]

[h2]What's new:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 45K words (about 5-7 hours of play)
[*] More Point & Click Mode and new locations
[*] 11 additional dialogues with the characters
[*] 2 secret easter eggs
[*] Greater variability of events
[*] Opening
[*] Gallery, Music room and Inventory
[*] Preview for Episode 3
[/list]

Guilty Parade ver. 2.3.2 does not support the save files that have been created in the earlier versions of the game. We strongly recommend that you start the game anew (the scenes that you have already seen can be skipped using the quick skip mode - Shift + >).

The demo version (Episode 1) has also been updated to version 2.3.2.

[previewyoutube=nmtuq4xqBfg;full][/previewyoutube]

We would love to hear your feedback!

[i]Nozori Games[/i]
